propositions: recheck-review currently refuses any finding state unconditionally, blocking retry of stale bugfix-size-attestation findings even after the required plan-review attestation is earned
bugfix-size-attestation findings require attestation state on the ticket (earned via rebar review-plan), not code changes, so the current refusal to retry is incorrect for this criterion
label copy condition NO_CODE_CHANGE / TRIVIAL_REBASE propagates stale bugfix-size-attestation findings forward, forcing unnecessary code changes to re-trigger review
recheck-review must accept a finding block when it contains exactly one bugfix-size-attestation finding and the ticket's plan-review attestation is in an accepted verdict bucket

the acceptance decision must read from privileged state only (bot vote message and ticket store) and reuse the gate's own classifier, never trusting the requesting comment for criterion id or ticket id
